card.name: Substitution and comparison wording
card.fires_on: Words that set one thing against or in place of another, such as 'instead', 'for' after 'Do not substitute [drug]', and 'match' or 'with' in comparisons. Also parts of the word biosimilar and 'matching' before placebo.

modes.label: The warning against substitution
modes.description: 'for' or 'instead' right after a warning not to replace one product with another.
modes.example: Do not substitute VIDAZA<< for>> oral azacitidine.

modes.label: Comparison with a reference
modes.description: Words that compare to a reference or equal item, such as 'match', 'with' or 'matching'.
modes.example: patients were randomized to receive either darbepoetin alfa treatment or a<< matching>> placebo.

modes.label: Biosimilar word
modes.description: Inside the word biosimilar when it is paired with a reference product.
modes.example: no clinically meaningful differences between the bios<<imilar>> product and the reference product.
